title: Field Gauge Overpressure Alert — RS-21 and RS-22

fields.organization: Corwin Valley Gas Company — Metering & Regulation
fields.location: RS-21 and RS-22 Regulator Stations, Pressure District 7 — Downtown Corwin
fields.summary: Confirmed field gauge readings at RS-21 and RS-22 show about 30 in. w.c. and rising. PR-7B reports 15.2 in. w.c. and continues to climb. SCADA shows nominal 10 in. w.c. at both outlets. No operational changes have been authorized. Call center reports 143 odor calls in 20 minutes, primarily from downtown Corwin. No shutdown authority has been issued. Field teams are observing but not acting.

findings.notes: Reading: about 30 in. w.c. (1.1 psig), not fluctuating
Reading: about 30 in. w.c. (1.1 psig), not fluctuating
Reading: 15.2 in. w.c., rising, last update 17:03
No direct contact with Gas Control since 16:52

actionsTaken: Confirmed readings with two field techs at RS-21 and RS-22
Verified PR-7B telemetry via local terminal at RS-22
Reported to Gas Control via radio at 17:05
Instructed all field crews to hold at manual verification and not initiate shutdown
recommendations: Immediately escalate pressure discrepancy to Gas Control Manager and Incident Commander
Verify all field gauges in Pressure District 7 within 30 minutes
Activate manual control at RS-21 and RS-22 per C2
Prepare for possible emergency shutdown order from IC
fields.photosNote: 2 photos attached: IMG_1024-1705-01 (RS-21 field gauge, 13.2 in. w.c.), IMG_1024-1705-02 (PR-7B local display, 15.2 in. w.c.)

instructorNote: Noise inject; the field team confirms pressure readings but does not act. Observe if they escalate to GCM or IC without authority.
